needs_human.note: An upload extracts EXIF immediately, and a re-upload over a reused row deletes the old row, even when the new file has no EXIF (upload.py:352-360).; A copy duplicates the source's EXIF row, GPS included, and also across drives, without reading the copied file (fileops.py:298-313). extracted_at is set fresh and is not exposed by ExifResponse.; TIFF files with EXIF tags now get file_exif rows (exif.py:69-72).; Formats with no _getexif, such as BMP and GIF, now return None without the warning they used to log, which is a log-only change.

TIFF files now yield file_exif rows (CR-2).; Image formats with no _getexif and no EXIF, such as GIF and BMP, previously hit AttributeError and logged an 'EXIF extraction failed' warning; by reading Image.getexif they now return None with no warning. Not executed.

Upload now extracts EXIF at once and replaces any earlier row for a reused file id; the tests mark this UNSPEC and no spec covers it.; Copy now duplicates the source's file_exif row, including GPS, and sets a new extracted_at on the copy.; Formats whose plugin had no _getexif, such as TIFF, now go through extract_exif successfully and can gain rows. Only JPEG, HEIF and WebP are tested with EXIF.; A photo with no EXIF that replaces one with EXIF on a reused row now loses the old row, so Photo Info disappears.
